name: Blood Diamond

features.name: Chained Reels
features.description: Link reels so they show identical symbols.

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Stacked wilds that gain multipliers as they nudge.

features.name: xNudge Desire
features.description: Adds one to five xNudge Wilds at random.

review:
Character symbols land in stacks up to four high and count as that many symbols. Chained Reels switch on at random, linking two or more reels so they land the same symbols.

Stacked xNudge wilds always nudge into view and gain +1 per nudge, and xNudge Desire can drop one to five of them in – if one lands on a chained reel, it copies across every linked reel. That's the big combo. Extreme volatility, 14,780x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
